summary: Cursor currently lists a $0/month Free plan with limited Agent and Chat requests. Usage is a shared AI pool across Cursor and Grok that refreshes weekly; no fixed Free quota is published on the pricing page. Cloud agents/automations and third-party model access are not included in Free. Higher plans unlock additional features; third-party model usage is billed separately.
claim_steps: Go to https://cursor.com/pricing and select Get started under the Free ($0/month) plan.
Download and install the Cursor editor.
Sign in with a free account.
Use Agent and Chat within the shared free allowance; check usage in settings. Paid plans add features as well as larger allowances, and third-party model usage is billed separately.

social_proof.title: Cursor · Pricing
social_proof.text: Free $0 /month. Limited agent requests. Limited Chat requests. Your allowance refreshes weekly, so one heavy day never wipes out your whole month.
